meta.title: Saudi API Catalogue
meta.description: A verified, bilingual catalogue of Saudi government, open-data, financial and business APIs, with examples, evidence and an MCP server for AI agents.

home.heading: Every Saudi API, checked at its source
home.lede: Find government, open-data, finance, payments, tax, commerce, transport and health APIs. See who may use each one, how it authenticates and a request you can run, in Arabic and English.
home.invocableLede: Keyless APIs whose terms allow automated calls. AI agents can call them through the MCP server.
home.agentsTitle: Use the catalogue from an AI agent
home.agentsLede: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client to search the catalogue, read an API's documentation and call open endpoints.
home.datasetsLede: {count} datasets from GASTAT, SAMA, ministries and others, refreshed daily from DataSaudi.

about.title: About
about.lede: An open-source catalogue of Saudi APIs for developers and AI agents.
about.evidenceBody: Each entry is checked against the provider's own documentation or a live request, and shows the date and the links. When a provider does not publish a detail, the entry says so instead of guessing. Several government hosts refuse connections from outside Saudi Arabia; their reachability shows where the check ran from.
about.policyBody: The platform follows each host's robots.txt, keeps to a per-provider request budget, identifies itself in every request, and never sends credentials. Datasets keep their publisher's name and link; cite them when you reuse the figures.
about.independentBody: This catalogue is not affiliated with, endorsed by or operated by any government entity or provider listed in it. Provider names identify the sources of their own APIs.
about.contributeBody: The catalogue lives in a public repository. Propose a new API or a correction through a pull request; the curation guide explains what evidence an entry needs.

footer.independent: Not affiliated with any government entity.
